semantics.admission: A mapped group with any positive known establishments, workplace jobs or annual payroll is eligible for a later compiler; admission creates no worksite or person. Every other group remains source context.
semantics.completeness: Each measure independently retains its checked known subtotal and published member count. Complete total exists only when all source members publish that measure; unknown members are never observed zeros.
semantics.context: Code 99 has no function and is never admitted. All 3,144 counties remain in the independent county roster; Kalawao's residents do not imply an observed workplace.
semantics.limits: No jobs-to-persons conversion, household allocation, physical recipe, operating capacity, opening stock, current wage payment or game-state hydration follows from this capture.
semantics.members: Exact disjoint source NAICS members once each, sorted lexically; tuple naics~P/N~establishments~jobs~payroll~mean_weekly_wage separated by semicolons. Blank quantity is unknown, not zero. Source basis preserves source aggregation-level identity.
semantics.suppression: N preserves published establishments while jobs, payroll and mean weekly wage remain unknown. P means published source row; absent county/group remains absent.
semantics.wages: Published mean weekly wage is retained only per source member; means are never added or averaged into cohort wages.
